# Closure Report Skill Context
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

This skill routes closure-report requests through the smallest ACTS stage that can complete them. Read `SKILL.md` for the full stage contracts.

## Routes

| Request | Load | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Draft or revise | `SKILL.md` Build section and Build references | Current-run closure report and handoff |
| Audit quality | `SKILL.md` Measure section and Measure references | Gate result and correction route |
| Ask what happens next | `SKILL.md` Learn section and Learn references | `what-now.md` after a passed gate |
| Pause or resume | `SKILL.md` run setup and state references | Durable run state |
| Show status | `SKILL.md` Status section | Current stage and quality state |

## Selective Loading

- Load `definition.md` and `closure-report-template.md` for Build.
- Load `acceptance-criteria.md`, `quality-rubric.md`, and `quality-policy.md` for Measure.
- Load `what-now-template.md`, `quality-policy.md`, and `run-state-template.md` for Learn.
- Load `review-policy.md` only when a human review or approval decision affects the route.
- Load `test-scenarios.md` only when validating the skill package.

Do not load prior runs, legacy outputs, or unrelated references unless the selected stage declares them.
